name: Drag Trail Scatter
description: Draggable image that, while held, scatters a ring of trail images around it that chase the pointer with lag, blur and rotation, then collapse back into the main image on release.
contents: Full-section colored background with large centered title
One or more draggable image stacks, each with a main image and trail images
Caption hint in the bottom right corner
behavior: Pressing the main image scales it down and fans the trail images out in a circle around it
Dragging moves the image; trails follow with randomized easing, scale, rotation and motion blur based on drag speed
Releasing collapses the trails back into the image and scales it back up
Stacks raise to the front when grabbed, works with touch and mouse via pointer events
editableByProps: Images, number of stacks and trail images per stack
Title and caption text, visibility and colors, background color
Image size, trail spread, easing, scale, rotation and blur strength
fixed: Sets the body cursor to grabbing while dragging and resets it on release and unmount
